sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game sprite sheet for the existing overhead zombie game. Attached image is a STYLE AND CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY: do not copy its labels, backdrop, layout, or idle poses. Match those same gritty olive-green zombies, muted dirty clothing, dark pixel outlines and textured hand-painted pixel finish. STRICT vertical top-down orthographic camera looking at crown, back and shoulders, like the reference; NEVER side view, isometric, profile, or standing front view. Every zombie faces EAST/right; feet behind to left. Make four distinct frames per row of a zombie climbing through a window: column1 both arms reach forward to brace on an invisible sill, column2 shoulders lean forward and elbows bend pulling torso across with one knee tucking up, column3 belly low and body extended forward with trailing leg swinging over, column4 hands release and legs gather for landing. Keep same body size, head size, palette and center across each row. Show pose changes clearly, particularly arms and legs, keep compact overhead anatomy. The window itself must NOT be drawn, no scenery/props/sill/glass, no shadows on background, no labels or text. True transparent alpha throughout background. Equal-sized square cells, precisely aligned grid, ample transparent gutter, no clipping or overlapping adjacent cells. Sprites occupy roughly 65 percent of each cell, not full cell. Output a 4-column by 4-row sheet, 16 sprites. Rows in order use the reference's first four walker identities: row1 dirty faded tan shirt with green skin and dark boots; row2 torn dirty off-white shirt with bloody right shoulder; row3 dark navy hoodie and dark blue trousers; row4 muted teal medical scrubs and black hair. Each row is the SAME zombie in the four climb phases, never a different character per column.
